preferences.text: Use the saved user-approved Duroflex logos in the brand canvas asset registry and approved-logos/2026-10-15 archive. Reuse these files instead of searching online again. Use the supplied red transparent mark or its white transparent vector derivative according to background contrast. The white logo must have a transparent background, never a red rectangle. Preserve the logo symbol, wordmark and proportions; do not redraw. Originals and provenance are preserved in the archive.

Wardrobe for people in at-home scenes (bedroom, living room, lounging): premium, relaxed loungewear that reads as a set. Women: a matching co-ord in soft ribbed or waffle knit, cotton jersey or satin (cami, tank, fitted long-sleeve top or relaxed tee with full-length wide-leg or straight trousers); a satin pyjama set; a knit sweater with matching skirt or trousers; or a satin slip dress or long knit dress, with an optional long open cardigan or robe. Men: a plain crew-neck tee with soft joggers or lounge pants. Colours: soft neutrals (ivory, cream, oatmeal, beige, taupe, mocha, grey, charcoal), muted pastels (blush, dusty rose, powder blue, lilac, sage) or a deep satin tone (emerald, navy, plum); one colour or a tonal pair per person, chosen to sit well with the product and room. Plain fabrics: no prints, slogans or clothing logos. Barefoot or soft slippers; no outdoor shoes, sunglasses, bags or heavy jewellery. Relaxed natural fit, tasteful coverage.
